description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.
